Name: Shu-A Custom Npc From Arknights
Author: EndlessPathB103
Description:
[center][b][color=#ffd966]大家好！花费了近两个月的时间，终于又把关于黍的人物模组制作好了！[/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][u]很抱歉出现了一点点小bug！大家只要重新下载模组就可以了！！[/u][/b][/center]
v1.01:修复节日站位问题与对话问题，以及添加一个新的禽舍动物——黍兔兔，6666G，每天生产稀有种子。
走出农场就可以接到黍的第一个事件啦！黍的试验田可以通过公交站进入。
关于黍的日程和喜好，都可以参考LookupAnything模组，这里不多赘述。
与黍结婚不会生孩子，而是领养我们超级可爱的[u]黍泡泡[/u]！婚后，黍也会提到黍泡泡的生活，比如“我回来了。黍泡泡有没有捣乱？我今天在试验田发现了一株野生的草莓，已经开花了……”另外，黍在婚后会经常给你做吃的。
游戏内一共新增了四个地图，黍的试验田，黍的家，龙泡泡专卖店（8心）以及大荒一隅（8心），和两首音乐，其中包含《赴大荒》，你可以在留声机听到它们！
黍时不时也会往我们的农场送邮件，一共有7种不同的邮件。
黍一共有19个事件，其中有2个需要下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38308]龙泡泡NPC[/url]模组才可以正常触发。8心事件后，我们可以通过矿车前往“龙泡泡专卖店”[s]（不过作者暂时没有想好塞什么）[/s]
在10心事件的时候，她会给我们一个全新的改良稻种——可以在四季都能种植的小麦。小麦需要六天的时间生长，其后每天成熟，价格翻了四倍。以及下载前置TrinketTinker且与黍达到12心后，可以在农舍触发一个黍赠与饰品的事件，饰品如下：
[i]-东升日头西降月，春寒有雨夏寒晴-自动跟踪8格内的作物。每66秒回复1%至5%的生命值，每300秒回复15%至30%的体力值，每30秒挖掘范围3*3的土地，每5秒收获范围3*3的作物，摇晃灌木丛，或是挖掘远古斑点。符文：耕种等级+8，采集等级+8，钓鱼等级+8，幸运+8，最大能量值+66，防御+6。附：每日有一定概率变成黍泡泡。[/i]
[center]==========================================================[/center]
[center][color=#ffd966]Hello everyone! After nearly two months of work, I've finally finished the character mod for Shu![/color][/center]
You can trigger Shu's first event right after stepping out of your farm. Shu's experimental field can be accessed via the bus stop.
For Shu's schedule and gift preferences, you can refer to the LookupAnything mod, so I won't go into detail here.
Marrying Shu won't result in having children; instead, you'll adopt our super adorable Shu Bean! After marriage, Shu will also mention Shu Bean' daily life, for example: "I'm home. Did Shu Bean cause any trouble? Today I found a wild strawberry plant in the experimental field, and it's already blooming..." Additionally, after marriage, Shu will often cook food for you.
The mod adds four new maps: Shu's Experimental Field, Shu's House, DragonBeans Specialty Shop (8 hearts), and A Corner of Dahuang (8 hearts), along with two music tracks, including "To Dahuang" — you can listen to them on the jukebox!
Shu will occasionally send you mail on your farm, with a total of 7 different letters.
Shu has 19 events in total, two of which require downloading the DragonBeans NPC mod to trigger properly. After the 8-heart event, you can take the minecart to the "DragonBeans Specialty Shop" (though the author hasn't decided what to put in it yet).
During the 10-heart event, Shu will give you a brand new improved rice seed — wheat that can be grown in all four seasons. This wheat takes six days to grow, then matures daily afterward, and sells for four times the normal price. Additionally, after installing the prerequisite TrinketTinker and reaching 12 hearts with Shu, you can trigger an event in the farmhouse where Shu gifts you a trinket with the following effects:
[list]
[*][i][b]In east sun lifts; in west moons fall. Spring cold foretells rain; summer chill, clear skies.[/b] – Automatically tends crops within 8 tiles. Recovers 1%-5% health every 66 seconds, and 15%-30% energy every 300 seconds. Tills 3x3 soil every 30 seconds. Harvests 3x3 crops, shakes bushes, or digs up artifact spots every 5 seconds. Enchantments: Farming +8, Foraging +8, Fishing +8, Luck +8, Max Energy +66, Defense +6. P.S.: Has a certain daily chance to transform into a Shu Bean.[/i][/*]
[/list]
